name: codex-provider-picker
goal: Prove a local plugin picker lists native OpenAI and Claude separately, durably queues per-thread changes, reports unknown/pending honestly, and never changes global defaults; desktop installation/application remains pending

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: User authorized local picker implementation on 2026-10-08 with desktop installation/application pending. Criteria recorded in specification/features/planned/codex-provider-picker.md. OpenAI remains default; explicit sessions and unknown active state required.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented a portable MCP conversation entrypoint, shared-component Svelte picker, catalog discovery, owner-only SQLite queue, explicit session binding, cancellation and internal verified application boundary. No desktop adapter is installed; OpenAI defaults remain unchanged. Native CLI installation into the user plugin cache succeeded; installed HTML/server/manifest hashes match this build.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red before implementation: ProviderSwitchService and internal apply tests failed on missing methods; browser regression failed because provider combobox was missing; the current MCP CLI regression failed against an isolated prechange source snapshot with Connection closed. The same regressions now pass. Focused checks cover persistence, isolation, deduplication, cancellation, catalog validation, pending/applied boundary and rollback.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
